title: Questions 147-148 refer to the following notice.
passage_1:
Weyburn Bridge Celebration

The Weyburn Riverside Association is organizing a parade next month to mark 150 years since our bridge first opened. We are currently inviting local businesses and community groups to participate.

The main feature of the evening will be a giant balloon shaped like a bridge, featuring designs inspired by the river’s working past. Participants are encouraged to be creative. If your organization would like to sponsor the parade, please contact Priya Raman at p.raman@weyburn.org for information about sponsorship opportunities.
